title: Sheep Along a Footpath in Amager Fælled
alt: Sheep resting beneath a tree and beside a footpath through the open grassland of Amager Fælled, Denmark.
commentary: Starting my walk through Amager Fælled, the sheep (Ovis aries) had already found one of the few shady spots in the open meadow. A wonderfully relaxed introduction to the area.
lensModel: Pixel 9 Pro XL back camera 6.9mm f/1.68
